strongest_dissent.verbatim: Given the current state of evidence, it is strongly advised against funding the proposed enterprise rollout of the coding agent due to several unresolved security concerns. The open prompt-injection vulnerability (ev-008) remains unaddressed at scale, posing an enterprise risk. Additionally, the pilot did not exercise the agent against any system handling regulated customer data (ev-015), leaving uncertainty about its applicability to such systems in a full rollout. Lastly, new regulatory guidance recommends human review of AI-suggested code changes before merge for regulated systems, but a documented process for this is yet to be established (ev-012). Until these security questions are adequately addressed, the potential risks outweigh the benefits of the proposed rollout.
